scope: Bounded text-source syntax contract for five pinned Godot 4 engines; not semantic, AST-value, runtime, project or bytecode conformance.

acceptance.reason: Reviewed finite text-source grammar contract accepted for five fixed engines. All 255 original scripts agree in all five profiles; 227550 deterministic physical-token mutations terminate and preserve source. Four official baseline exceptions are explicitly excluded with follow-up IDs. No complete-language semantics claim.
